title: No smoking here
goal: State rules and ask how things are done, with the passive and no subject.

intro.text: With no subject, the passive says what people in general do, or may do: *Bu ýerde çilim çekilmeýär* (no smoking here), *Muzeýe nädip barylýar?* (how do you get to the museum?). The verb stays in the plain third person.

vocab.en: floor, storey (ikinji gat: the second floor)
up, upward (ýokary çykmak: to go up)

exercises.question: A sign in a park says *Bu ýerde çilim çekilmeýär.* What does it mean?

exercises.prompt: How does one get to the museum?
accept: Muzeýe nädip barylýar?
Muzeýe nädip gidilýär?
Muzeýe nädip barmaly?
Muzeýe nädip baryp bolýar?

reject.why: That asks how **you** get there. For **one**, people in general, use the passive with no person: *barylýar*.

exercises.en: People don't talk loudly in the library.

accept: n

reject.why: After **l** and a vowel the passive is *-n*: *gürlenmeýär*.

exercises.gloss: one goes there, you get there
exercises.explain: *bar-* + *-yl* + *-ýar*. No subject, so no person ending.

accept: You do not go in with your shoes on.
You do not [go|come] inside with your shoes on.
You do not come in with your shoes on.
People do not [go|come] [in|inside] with their shoes on.
No shoes inside.

exercises.question: Which sentence states a general rule, with no subject?

why.2: *Ýüzmeýär*: **he** or **she** doesn't swim in this lake.

exercises.explain: *ýüz-* + *-ül* + *-me-ýär*: nobody swims here. No swimming in this lake.

exercises.prompt: How do you get up to the third floor?

accept: Bu ýerde türkmençe gürlenýär.
Bu ýerde türkmen dilinde gürlenýär.
Bu ýerde türkmençe gürleýärler.
Bu ýerde türkmen dilinde gürleýärler.

reject.why: *Gürleýär* is **he** or **she speaks**. With no subject, use the passive: *gürlenýär*.

exercises.explain: *gürle-* + *-n* + *-ýär*: Turkmen is spoken. The active with **they**, *gürleýärler*, works too.

accept: You go up to the second floor by lift.
You get up to the second floor by lift.
You [go|get] up to the second floor [in the lift|by elevator|in the elevator].
[Take|Use] the [lift|elevator] to the second floor.
One goes up to the second floor by lift.

exercises.question: *Wokzala ___ barylýar?* (How do you get to the station?)

why.1: *Nähili* asks what something is like: *Howa nähili?*

exercises.explain: *Nädip* asks **how, in what way** something is done.

accept: Bu kölde ýüzülmeýär.
Bu kölde ýüzmek gadagan.
Bu kölde ýüzmeli däl.

reject.why: *Ýüzmeýär* is **he doesn't swim**. For a rule with no subject: *ýüzülmeýär*.

exercises.question: Why does *Bu ýerde çilim çekilmeýär* have no person ending?
options: It has no subject: it is about people in general.

why.1: Nobody in particular is meant: it is a rule for everyone.

exercises.explain: The passive with no subject stays in the plain third person: *çekilmeýär*.

accept: You can also go to Ashgabat by train.
You can go to Ashgabat by train too.
You can also get to Ashgabat by train.
One can also go to Ashgabat by train.
People also go to Ashgabat by train.
You also go to Ashgabat by train.
